identity.description: Consumer agent that submits a pipe task to stock-sim and consumes the resulting stock-price stream.

inputs.description: Optional stock request parameters. If omitted and the process is interactive, the handler will prompt before sending the task.

symbols.title: Stock Symbols
symbols.description: Comma-separated symbols to request from stock-sim.

durationMinutes.title: Duration (minutes)
durationMinutes.description: How long the provider should stream prices.

outputs.description: Summary of the streamed stock quotes.

skills.name: Consume Stock Stream
skills.description: Submits a pipe task to stock-sim and returns a summary of the streamed quotes.
